title: ks.state: versioned object store
outcome: SQLite-backed versioned store per ADR-05: get -> (value, ver, author), history(obj), put with before/after versions
acceptance: put/get/history round-trip with monotonic ver per object; put returns WriteEntry before/after ver+hash matching contracts C3
put raises if a row value carries a sensitive key (each datum in exactly one object); field create/delete writes/tombstones field objects (test_sensitive_field_object)
test_field_only_update_keeps_row_ver passes; store runs inside a caller-owned BEGIN IMMEDIATE txn

log.msg: Dependency on B3-01 is soft: the store needs no 1.2 field, start D1 on contracts 1.1.0 (keeps the critical path off the contracts bump)
→ in_progress: started: SQLite versioned store on contracts 1.1.0
